newsitem.title: USA: CNN has news deal with PageNet.
newsitem.headline: CNN has news deal with PageNet.

text.p: Turner Broadcasting System Inc's Cable News Network announced a deal on Thursday that would provide news to more than 600,000 customers of Paging Network Inc's wireless messaging service.

In a joint statement, the companies said electronic news would be available on alphanumeric pagers in eight categories: United States' news, world news, stock market reports, business news, weather, show business news, features and sports.
News reports would be updated every 30 minutes on weekdays and hourly on weekends by a special team assembled by CNN's CNN Interactive division.
CNN and PageNet also said they planned to explore the potential for customized service that would allow subscribers to dictate the type and frequency of the news they receive.
The new wireless news service, available to PageNet customers free of charge, is launched formally on September 19 at the PCIA Convention in San Francisco.
